contract: The Socket.IO connection hook on the prefixed Engine.IO path (/audiobookshelf/socket.io) creates one client record per connection, associates no user and emits no event until the client sends auth, and drops anonymous records on disconnect without announcing them.
exceptions: Named tests are assertion leads, not complete coverage or a current execution claim. Missing source/client state and failure variants remain required.
force is not applicable: a transport connection has no force or override mode.

invariants.contract: A connection receives no init, auth_failed or user_online before its auth event succeeds; a successful auth yields exactly one init and one usersOnline entry and writes users.lastSeen; rejected credentials leave the client anonymous (no usersOnline entry, no lastSeen write) and their disconnect announces no user_offline; concurrent connections authenticate independently and one connection's auth never initializes another.
